auditor_verdict: DISAGREE. The latest capacities are indeed exactly 32× defaults (163,840 rooms and 5,242,880 notes), but capacities fluctuate from 20,480 to 250,000 rooms and 655,360 to 5,242,880 notes, while totals plateau below the latest limits at 46,522 and 2,753,430; thus enforcement and the cause remain unproven. Near-10 MiB room files support rotation, not the claimed quota configuration.
